title: Mud is Fun
lines: Tim sat in the mud. Mud is fun!
A pup sat in the mud.
Mud is on Tim. Mud is on the pup.
Dad sat up. "Not in the mud, Tim!"
"Do it, Dad! It is fun," said Tim.
Mud is on Dad. It is on us!
It is fun to nap in the sun.

questions.ask: Who sat down in the mud at the end?
questions.listenFor: Dad. The story says it plainly. If your child says Tim, point to the line and read it together.

questions.ask: What did Tim say to Dad?
questions.listenFor: Do it, Dad. It is fun. You want the idea that Tim talked Dad into it - that change of mind is the whole story.

questions.ask: Which bit did you like best — Tim in the mud, or Dad in the mud?
questions.listenFor: Either. Ask them to read the line their bit is on, so the pick stays tied to the page.
